canonical_event_rule: unique hypothesis/symbol/date rows present at H=5; Phase 3 final event cohort
session_counting: entry session is H=1; observed eligible rows, no calendar-day arithmetic

entry_exit.S3-A/S3-D: signal at close t; hypothetical adjusted next-session open entry; close at t+H; H=1 exits entry-session close
entry_exit.S3-B: signal at close t; next-session open entry; close at t+H; H=1 exits next-session close; outcome subtracts official TradeSim-history SET50 price-index close-to-close return from t through t+H
entry_exit.S3-C: gap observed after open; hypothetical entry at gap-session close (not an open fill); close H observed sessions later

source: approved PIT daily stock rows only; no Settrade/TradeSim stock OHLCV blended; official TradeSim price-index series used as S3-B relative-return baseline

costs.one_tick_each_side: adverse one SET tick at raw entry and exit, using scripts/run_design_a_backtest.py tick schedule; OHLC proxy only, not a fill model
costs.returns_are: daily-bar adjusted-price estimates; no BBO, queue, executable volume, or IOC fill probabilities

controls.S3-A/S3-B/S3-D: same-date PIT-eligible non-event securities; exact frozen events retained
controls.S3-C: same symbol and calendar year, eligible non-gap observations; control returns direction-aligned to event gap

uncertainty: 10,000 two-way date/symbol pigeonhole bootstrap; seed=20261101 plus horizon/cost offsets; small symbol-cluster count limits reliability; Holm across 32 horizon tests within each cost scenario
reuse_and_oos: Every source observation used here has been inspected in prior research; no independent OOS. Chronological slices and horizon reanalysis do not create new confirmation.
promotion: No Phase 3 rejection is reopened; this distribution cannot pass G1 or promote a signal.
